useWhen: A public web URL is needed quickly
No native device capability is required
The user has no stronger stack preference
frontend: React only when client-side state is required
styling: CSS design tokens; add Tailwind only when justified
database: D1 + Drizzle only when persistence is required
storage: R2 only when files are required
background: Queues or Workflows only when asynchronous durability is required
realtime: Durable Objects only when coordination is required
